reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes PlusToken as a way to receive daily passive income, including up to 18% returns, and directs viewers to register through the video description. The speaker also ties earnings to partners across multiple sponsor lines and instructs viewers to use referral cards with their own partners, making recruitment a central part of the promoted earning structure.

distributed through sponsor lines
100 percent from the income of all your partners in the front line and 10 percent of the income from the second to the tenth line deeper
If you want to participate in the arbitration program and receive passive income, click the iDock button
When you register, make sure to fill in the referral card of the person who recommend this wallet to you.

opening.argument: The presentation includes an explicit caution against treating the opportunity as risk-free market certainty: viewers are told to compare conditions with the roadmap and warned that rapid exchange listings can lead to a token crash. It also acknowledges that the market can be unpredictable and recommends distributing holdings across several currencies to reduce risk. Those qualifications matter: the speaker is presenting an opportunity with conditions and volatility, not simply certifying an unavoidable profit. The reference-side excerpts emphasize promotional language but omit these material warnings and the speaker's acknowledgment that token markets can fall.

citations.quote: please be careful and compare your conditions with the roadmap and know that a quick listing of fresh tokens at the publicly available exchanges means in most cases a crash of a token
it is better to distribute them to several types of currencies, since this is the market and sometimes it can be unpredictable
This is necessary in cannot reduce your risk

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited caution does not neutralize the central offer. In the same presentation, the speaker promises passive income “up to 18%,” calls it revenue “without risk,” and describes daily profit. A warning about token listings and diversification is compatible with promoting a specific income scheme; it does not qualify the promised returns or explain the basis for paying them.

citations.quote: receive a passive income of up to 18% without paying for a subscription
This is the opportunity to receive revenue without risk
Every day profit in tokens is incurred

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The warnings are general market comments, while the concrete offer remains unusually specific: daily passive income up to 18% and revenue without risk. Advising diversification does not show that the advertised return is conditional, independently verified, or merely hypothetical. The caution therefore adds rhetorical balance without changing what viewers are invited to pursue.

opening.argument: The video can be read as an operational demonstration of a cryptocurrency wallet and its exchange features. It explains how to deposit bitcoin by selecting Bitcoin, pressing the deposit button, viewing a QR code, and copying the displayed address; it then explains how to activate or cancel arbitration and how accumulated tokens may be exchanged or reinvested. This is concrete product instruction, not merely a demand for payment. The supplied frames likewise show wallet menus and a PLUS-branded interface, consistent with demonstrating how the software is organized. Instructional detail should not be converted into proof that the service is fraudulent.

citations.quote: If you want to deposit bitcoins, then you click on Bitcoin, then on the yellow button Deposit. After this, a QR code opens.
If you want to participate in the arbitration program and receive passive income, click the iDock button, then push the slider to the right opposite the desired currency.
You can exchange the accumulated profit here in your share at any time and to be cashed.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The walkthrough is not neutral software education. It repeatedly links the demonstrated controls to earning passive income, deposits, referrals, partner payments, and registration through the description. Explaining how to use a wallet is the delivery mechanism for the solicitation, not evidence that the promoted earning structure is ordinary technology instruction.

citations.quote: If you want to participate in the arbitration program and receive passive income, click the iDock button
When you register, make sure to fill in the referral card of the person who recommend this wallet to you.
100 percent from the income of all your partners in the front line and 10 percent of the income from the second to the tenth line deeper

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational detail does not change the video's purpose. The tutorial explicitly teaches viewers how to activate the income feature and how to move funds into the wallet, while the presentation also directs registration and referral participation. A software demonstration would explain functions without making daily earnings and partner income the reason to use them.

Every day profit in tokens is incurred

opening.argument: At its most defensible reading, this is promotion of a wallet service with optional exchange and referral features. The described mechanics include a free installation, cryptocurrency deposits, a wallet interface, and the ability to stop arbitration and regain access to the currency. The material does not establish that the presenter collects a deposit personally, requests a viewer's login credentials, or shows a completed withdrawal or failed transaction. A referral card and partner rewards can occur in ordinary product promotion; their presence alone does not prove that the underlying wallet is a scam. The evidence supports a service pitch, but not the conclusion that every promotional claim is fraudulent.

citations.quote: without paying for a subscription, without paying for a license, completely free of charge to install an crypto wallet on your phone
If you urgently need some money, you shift the slider
you know your login and password, you can enter your wallet from your phone

rebuttal.rebuttal: The missing examples do not matter because the solicitation is explicit on the supplied record. Viewers are told to register, use referral cards, deposit cryptocurrency, and expect income from partners through ten levels. Calling this a wallet service does not explain why compensation depends on a downline or why the presentation promotes passive returns.

citations.quote: When you register, make sure to fill in the referral card of the person who recommend this wallet to you.
100 percent from the income of all your partners in the front line and 10 percent of the income from the second to the tenth line deeper
If you want to deposit bitcoins, then you click on Bitcoin, then on the yellow button Deposit.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a shown failed withdrawal does not make the claims ordinary commerce. The presentation expressly offers passive income and specifies commissions from partners in the first and second through tenth lines. Those are not merely incidental referral discounts; they are described as sources of the viewer's income, alongside the wallet's promoted returns.
